question: What was the time-weighted average spread for AAPL and MSFT in 15-minute buckets on 2026.10.02?
q: select twas:dur wavg ask-bid by sym,bucket:0D00:15 xbar time from update dur:(next time)-time by sym,src from select time,sym,src,bid,ask from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym in `AAPL`MSFT

question: On 2026.10.02, how many AAPL fills executed at the bid, at the ask, inside the prevailing quote, or outside it, by side?
q: select n:count sym by side,status:?[price=bid;`atbid;?[price=ask;`atask;?[price within (bid;ask);`inside;`outside]]] from aj[`sym`time; select time,sym,side,price from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL; select time,sym,bid,ask from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL]

question: For each AAPL fill between 10:00 and 10:10 on 2026.10.02, what was the VWAP of the five minutes up to and including that fill?
q: select time,price,size,vwap5:(sumps-sumps5)%sumsz-sumsz5 from aj[`sym`time; select time,sym,price,size,sumps:sums price*size,sumsz:sums size from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL; select time:time+0D00:05,sym,sumps5:sumps,sumsz5:sumsz from select time,sym,sumps:sums price*size,sumsz:sums size from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL] where time within (2026.10.02D10:00;2026.10.02D10:10)

question: Per instrument, how many fills on 2026.10.02 were more than two standard deviations from that instrument's own mean price for the day? Use the population standard deviation, not the sample one. Give a count for each instrument that had at least one.
q: select outliers:count sym by sym from trades where date=2026.10.02,abs[price-(avg;price) fby sym]>2*(dev;price) fby sym

question: Between 10:00 and 10:15 on 2026.10.02, what was the average round-trip cost per share of 500 shares of AAPL, walking the five levels of the book?
q: select cost500:avg (deltas[0;500&sums (asize1;asize2;asize3;asize4;asize5)] wavg (ask1;ask2;ask3;ask4;ask5))-deltas[0;500&sums (bsize1;bsize2;bsize3;bsize4;bsize5)] wavg (bid1;bid2;bid3;bid4;bid5) by sym from depth where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL,time within (2026.10.02D10:00;2026.10.02D10:15)

question: For each AAPL fill between 10:00 and 10:10 on 2026.10.02, how much had the price moved in the five minutes before it?
q: select time,price,pminus5,change:price-pminus5 from aj[`sym`time; select time,sym,price from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL,time within (2026.10.02D10:00;2026.10.02D10:10); select time:time+0D00:05,sym,pminus5:price from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL]

question: What was the average cumulative volume profile for MSFT in 30-minute buckets across 2026.10.02 to 2026.10.08?
q: select cumvol:avg cv by sym,bucket from select date,sym,bucket,cv:(sums;vol) fby date from select vol:sum size by date,sym,bucket:0D00:30 xbar `timespan$time from trades where date within (2026.10.02;2026.10.08),sym=`MSFT

question: Give me hourly open, high, low and close bars for AAPL and MSFT on 2026.10.02, on the clock hour (09:00, 10:00 and so on), with each bar's open carried from the previous bar's close.
q: update open:open^prev close by sym from select open:first price,high:max price,low:min price,close:last price by sym,bucket:0D01:00 xbar time from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym in `AAPL`MSFT

question: Show MSFT's volume for every minute from 09:30 to 09:59 on 2026.10.02, with zero for any minute that had no fills.
q: select sym,time,volume:0^volume from lj[([]sym:enlist`MSFT) cross ([]time:2026.10.02D09:30+0D00:01*til 30); select volume:sum size by sym,time:0D00:01 xbar time from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`MSFT,time<2026.10.02D10:00]

question: For AAPL, which day between 2026.10.02 and 2026.10.08 had the largest disparity between its TWAP and its VWAP?
q: `disparity xdesc select date,twap,vwap,disparity:100*abs 1-twap%vwap from select twap:(next deltas time) wavg price,vwap:size wavg price by date from trades where date within (2026.10.02;2026.10.08),sym=`AAPL

question: On 2026.10.02, how many fills did an order receive on average, by side?
q: select fillsPerOrder:avg 0^n by side from (select orderID,side from orders where date=2026.10.02) lj select n:count sym by orderID from trades where date=2026.10.02

question: For each AAPL fill between 10:00 and 10:02 on 2026.10.02, show the quote NEAREST in time to the fill, even if that quote came after it.
q: select time,qtime,sym,side,price,bid,ask from aj[`sym`time; select time,sym,side,price from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL,time within (2026.10.02D10:00;2026.10.02D10:02); select time:time-(0D00:00^time-prev time) div 2,qtime:time,sym,bid,ask from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL]

question: On 2026.10.02, which venue quoted AAPL most often, and how long did each venue's quotes persist on average?
q: `n xdesc select n:count sym,avgLife:`timespan$avg next[time]-time by src from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL

question: Show the running VWAP through the first five minutes of AAPL trading on 2026.10.02, fill by fill.
q: select time,price,size,rvwap:(sums size*price)%sums size from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL,time within (2026.10.02D09:30;2026.10.02D09:35)

question: Of the quote updates for AAPL and MSFT on 2026.10.02, how many actually changed the bid or the ask?
q: select changed:sum chg,total:count sym by sym from update chg:(differ bid)|differ ask by sym,src from select sym,src,time,bid,ask from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym in `AAPL`MSFT

question: Split MSFT's fills on 2026.10.02 into four buckets of equal volume; when did each start and end, and how much traded in each?
q: select startTime:first time,endTime:last time,volume:sum size by volbucket:3&floor 4*(sums size)%sum size from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`MSFT

question: What was MSFT's VWAP and volume on 2026.10.02 in the four sessions 09:30-10:00, 10:00-12:00, 12:00-15:30 and 15:30-16:00?
q: select vwap:size wavg price,volume:sum size by session:2026.10.02D09:30 2026.10.02D10:00 2026.10.02D12:00 2026.10.02D15:30 bin time from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`MSFT

question: Pivot the daily closes of AAPL, MSFT and VOD from 2026.10.02 to 2026.10.08 into one column per symbol.
q: exec (`AAPL`MSFT`VOD)#sym!close by date:date from select close:last price by date,sym from trades where date within (2026.10.02;2026.10.08),sym in `AAPL`MSFT`VOD

question: Using one-minute last-trade prices, how correlated were AAPL and MSFT through 2026.10.02?
q: select correlation:cor[1_deltas aapl;1_deltas msft] from ((select aapl:last price by t:0D00:01 xbar time from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL) ij select msft:last price by t:0D00:01 xbar time from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`MSFT)

question: For AAPL's fills on 2026.10.02, what was the one-minute markout, by side?
q: select markoutBps:avg 1e4*?[side=`buy;mid1-price;price-mid1]%price by side from aj[`sym`time; select time,sym,side,price from trades where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL; select time:time-0D00:01,sym,mid1:(bid+ask)%2 from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL]

question: Which days between 2026.10.02 and 2026.10.08 had MSFT volume more than one standard deviation from the week's mean?
q: select date,volume from (select volume:sum size by date from trades where date within (2026.10.02;2026.10.08),sym=`MSFT) where abs[volume-avg volume]>dev volume

question: What fraction of 2026.10.02 was AAPL's quoted spread wider than one and a half times its median, time-weighted?
q: select wideShare:(sum ?[(ask-bid)>1.5*med ask-bid;next[time]-time;0D00:00])%sum next[time]-time by sym from quotes where date=2026.10.02,sym=`AAPL
